question: Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was an exponent of which form of Hindustani classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Khayal__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was a legendary figure in the world of Hindustani classical music, celebrated for his remarkable contributions.
 
• He was an exponent of the Khayal genre, which is a form of Hindustani classical singing known for its improvisation and flexibility, distinguishing itself from other classical forms with its intricate and expressive renditions.
 
• Khayal, which means "imagination" in Persian, allows performers to express their creativity and emotional depth through both the lyrics and the music.
 
• Pandit Bhimsen Joshi's performances were characterized by his powerful voice, technical skill, and deep emotional expression, making him one of the most revered Khayal vocalists of his time.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**
